scope: Frozen-feature operational pair classification; no attribution work, backbone training, model architecture changes, or O3c
source_separation: Generate pairs independently inside fixed source split; require disjoint canonical_fact_id, feature_row_id, and stable_source_record_sha256 across splits.
entity_feature: H_mention_fresh: frozen exact entity-mention mean hidden state, 2048D, float32; not normalized at cache source.
relation_feature: H_base_I0: frozen MR fact_H by certified canonical source row, 2048D, float32; not normalized at cache source.

pair_types.P2: same entity + different relation; negative/new; primary hard negative

pair_sampling.p1_priority: Prefer different object_value pairs before same-value repeated rows.

candidate_heads.A: Factorized cosine entity/relation scorers with trainable scalar scale/bias; same-key probability is product/equivalent summed logits.
candidate_heads.B: Train-only standardized frozen E/R inputs -> separate 64D linear key parts -> symmetric abs-difference/Hadamard pair features -> 64-hidden MLP.
candidate_heads.C: Two independent cosine-based entity/relation gates; final SameKey is the conjunction of validation-frozen gates.

training.checkpoint_selection: Validation-only operational score; choose candidate by mean score across seeds, deploy the median-validation-score seed (no ensemble).

threshold_selection: Validation only; maximize mean of SameKey F1, P1/update recall, P2 accuracy, and overall negative/new accuracy; deterministic threshold tie-breaks.
test_usage: TestA/TestB are untouched until candidates, thresholds, and the winner checkpoint have been frozen using train/validation only. Test metrics are never used for tuning or winner selection.
reconnect_policy: Do not reconnect until both offline and action-simulation gates pass. No O3c in this experiment.
